en.headline: Hong Kong students watch Tiananmen flag-raising on Beijing visit
en.dek: Education Secretary Choi Yuk-lin led a Hong Kong and Macao youth flag-team delegation of more than 1,300 people at the square on Sunday.
body: Secretary for Education Choi Yuk-lin led a Hong Kong and Macao youth flag-raising team delegation to watch the flag-raising ceremony at Tiananmen Square on Sunday, the Education Bureau said.

The visit group includes more than 1,300 primary, secondary and post-secondary students and teachers from Hong Kong and Macao, together with representatives of the Hong Kong Flag-guards Association and the Hong Kong Army Cadets Association. The five-day programme, titled Salute to the National Flag, runs from 18 to 22 September and is organised with the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Offices and the Beijing municipal government. Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki is the Hong Kong leader of the delegation.

Dr Choi said patriotism education needed to be experienced in person. She described the trip as a walking classroom, saying students could feel the formality of the ceremony and consider the history attached to the national flag. The group also visited Peking University, Tsinghua University and partner schools in Beijing.

On Saturday Dr Choi was in Tianjin, where she met Vice Mayor Zhai Lixin and witnessed a memorandum of cooperation between the Education Bureau and the Tianjin Municipal Education Commission. She is due to remain with the delegation in Beijing on Monday.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮率港澳升旗隊訪京團在天安門觀升旗
zh.dek: 訪京團超過1300名港澳師生周日在天安門廣場觀看升旗儀式，五日行程由18日至22日。
body: 教育局局長蔡若蓮周日帶領「向國旗敬禮」港澳青少年升旗隊代表訪京團，到天安門廣場觀看升旗儀式。
訪京團有超過1300名港澳中小學師生、專上學生，以及香港升旗隊總會及香港青少年軍總會的代表。五日行程由9月18日至22日，由港澳辦、北京市人民政府及港澳特區政府合辦，政務司司長陳國基出任港方團長。
蔡若蓮表示，愛國主義教育需要親身體會，今次訪京貫徹「行走的課堂」理念，讓學生感受升旗儀式的莊嚴，並思考國旗背後的歷史意義。代表團同日亦走訪北京大學、清華大完及北京市的中小學姆妹學校。
蔡若蓮周六到訪天津，與天津市副市長翟立新會面，並見證教育局與天津市教育委員會簽署教育合作備忘錄。她周一繼續在北京參與訪京團活動。
